titleEn: How Much Does a Bathroom Renovation Cost in North Vancouver (2026)? Real Prices from $18,000
titleZh: 北温哥华卫浴装修费用2026：真实价格从$18,000起
contentEn:
A bathroom renovation in North Vancouver costs between $18,000 and $75,000 depending on scope. This guide covers real prices from actual 2024-2026 Reno Stars projects in Lynn Valley, Deep Cove, Blueridge, and Central North Vancouver.

North Vancouver Bathroom Renovation Cost by Scope

Small refresh ($18,000-$28,000): New toilet, vanity, bathtub refinishing, fresh tile grout, LED lighting, and paint. No plumbing relocation. Typical timeline: 2-3 weeks.

Standard renovation ($28,000-$48,000): Full tub removal and walk-in shower install, new vanity with quartz countertop, modern faucet and fixture package, porcelain floor tile, exhaust fan upgrade. Timeline: 3-5 weeks.

Full gut and replan ($48,000-$75,000+): Moving drain lines, curbless zero-threshold shower, heated floors, double vanity, custom cabinetry, high-end fixtures. Timeline: 6-10 weeks.

What North Vancouver Homeowners Actually Paid in 2024-2026

Lynn Valley condo, 45 sq ft: $31,200. Replaced tub with tiled walk-in shower, new vanity, heated floor, and quartz countertop.

Blueridge single-family home, 70 sq ft: $52,800. Full gut, curbless shower, double vanity, heated towel radiator, custom tile.

Deep Cove character home, 55 sq ft: $61,400. Heritage-inspired design, clawfoot tub restoration, hand-painted tile accent wall, Douglas fir details.

Central North Vancouver townhouse, 40 sq ft: $24,900. Stand-up shower replacement, wall-hung vanity, new fixtures, and exhaust fan.

North Vancouver Permit Requirements

North Vancouver is split between the City of North Vancouver (CNV) and the District of North Vancouver (DNV). Both require a building permit for any work that moves plumbing, alters structural elements, or changes load-bearing walls. Simple fixture swaps without plumbing changes do not require a permit in either municipality.

For DNV properties in areas like Grouse Woods, and properties above elevations where radon is a known concern, an additional radon mitigation review may apply. Reno Stars coordinates directly with CNV and DNV planning departments for all permit applications.

Why North Vancouver Costs More Than Other Metro Vancouver Areas

Labour rates in North Vancouver run 8-12% higher than Surrey or Langley due to proximity to Vancouver and the density of mid-century homes that require more careful demolition. Many homes in Blueridge, Canyon Heights, and Norgate were built in the 1960s and contain asbestos in floor levelling compounds - testing and abatement adds $800-$3,000 to the project budget.

Limited contractor availability also affects pricing. North Vancouver's steep geography and parking restrictions in areas like Lonsdale add logistics costs that don't apply in flatter municipalities.

What Affects Your Final Cost

Plumbing relocation is the single biggest cost driver after the scope decision. Moving a toilet or shower drain requires opening the concrete slab (in condo buildings) or jackhammering through the subfloor (in houses). A single drain line move adds $2,500-$5,500 to the project.

Fixture selection has a wide range. A quality brushed nickel faucet from a reputable brand runs $180-$420. Designer fixtures from local suppliers can exceed $2,000 per fixture. Reno Stars helps clients balance quality with budget at the quoting stage.

How Long Does It Take

Design and permitting: 2-4 weeks. Most North Vancouver bathroom permits are processed within 10 business days for standard scope work. Structural or plumbing-heavy work in DNV may take 15 business days.

Construction: 2-10 weeks depending on scope (see above).

Post-construction punch list and inspection: 3-5 days.

Total: 5-16 weeks from first meeting to key handover.

Financing Options for North Vancouver Homeowners

Home Equity Line of Credit (HELOC): Most North Vancouver homeowners have substantial equity. Scotiabank, TD, and RBC offer dedicated renovation HELOCs with rates starting around prime + 0.25%.

First National and Bridgewater Bank specialize in contractor-funded renovation mortgages that bundle the purchase or refinance with renovation costs.

BC First Time Home Buyer Incentive and RRSP Home Buyers' Plan apply if you are purchasing and renovating simultaneously.

How much does a small bathroom renovation cost in North Vancouver

A small bathroom refresh in North Vancouver - new toilet, vanity, bathtub refinish, paint, and tile grout - costs $18,000 to $28,000. No plumbing relocation keeps the cost at the lower end.

Do I need a permit for a bathroom renovation in North Vancouver

You need a building permit if you are moving plumbing, altering structural elements, or changing load-bearing walls. Simple fixture swaps without plumbing changes do not require a permit in either the City or District of North Vancouver.

How long does a bathroom renovation take in North Vancouver

A standard bathroom renovation (no major plumbing moves) takes 5-8 weeks from design approval to key handover in North Vancouver. Full gut renovations with plumbing relocation take 10-16 weeks.

What neighbourhoods in North Vancouver has Reno Stars worked in

Reno Stars has completed projects in Lynn Valley, Deep Cove, Blueridge, Canyon Heights, Pemberton Heights, Westlynn, Upper Lonsdale, Lower Lonsdale, Hamilton, Capilano, Norgate, and the Lonsdale corridor.
contentZh:
北温哥华卫浴装修费用介乎$18,000至$75,000，视工程范围而定。本指南涵盖Reno Stars于2024至2026年在Lynn Valley、Deep Cove、Blueridge及北温市中心实际项目的真实价格。

北温哥华卫浴装修费用按工程范围

小型翻新（$18,000-$28,000）：更换马桶、浴室柜、浴缸翻新、瓷砖填缝、LED灯具及油漆。不涉及管道移动。典型工期：2至3周。

标准装修（$28,000-$48,000）：拆除旧浴缸并安装步入式淋浴间、新浴室柜配石英石台面、现代水龙头及五金件、陶瓷地砖、排气扇升级。工期：3至5周。

全拆重建（$48,000-$75,000+）：移动排水管道、无障碍平门槛淋浴间、地暖、双人浴室柜、定制橱柜、高端五金件。工期：6至10周。

2024至2026年北温哥华业主实际支付费用

Lynn Valley公寓，45平方尺：$31,200。将浴缸改造为铺砖步入式淋浴间、新浴室柜、地暖及石英石台面。

Blueridge独立屋，70平方尺：$52,800。全拆重建、无障碍淋浴间、双人浴室柜、加热毛巾架、定制瓷砖。

Deep Cove特色住宅，55平方尺：$61,400。Heritage风格设计、爪足浴缸修复、手绘瓷砖特色墙、花旗松木饰面。

北温哥华联排别墅，40平方尺：$24,900。站立式淋浴间更换、壁挂式浴室柜、新五金件及排气扇。

北温哥华许可证要求

北温哥华分为北温哥华市（CNV）及北温哥华区（DNV）。两者均要求移动管道、改动结构元件或变更承重墙的工程申请建筑许可证。简单更换五金件而不涉及管道改动无需许可证。

对于Grouse Woods等DNV辖区内物业，以及已知的氡气风险地区，可能需要额外的氡气缓解审查。Reno Stars直接与CNV及DNV规划部门协调所有许可证申请。

为何北温哥华费用高于大温其他地区

由于靠近温哥华市区及大量1960年代建成的住宅需要更细致的拆卸工程，北温哥华的劳动力成本比素里或兰利高8至12%。Blueridge、Canyon Heights及Norgate的许多住宅建于1980年代以前，地板找平层中含有石棉——检测和处理费用另加$800至$3,000。

承包商资源有限也影响价格。北温哥华陡峭的地形及Lonsdale等地区的停车限制带来了平缓地形地区所没有的物流成本。

影响最终费用的因素

管道移动是决定范围后最大的成本驱动因素。移动马桶或淋浴排水管需要在混凝土板（公寓建筑）或底层地板（独立屋）上开槽。单个排水管道移动费用另加$2,500至$5,500。

五金件选择价格差异大。来自可靠品牌的优质拉丝镍水龙头售价$180至$420。本地供应商的设计师五金件每个可达$2,000以上。Reno Stars在报价阶段帮助客户平衡质量与预算。

工期多久

设计与许可证：2至4周。大多数北温哥华标准卫浴许可证在10个工作日内处理完毕。DNV的结构性或管道密集型工程可能需要15个工作日。

施工：2至10周（视乎范围而定，请参阅上文）。

竣工清单及验收：3至5天。

总计：首次会面至交钥匙需5至16周。

北温哥华业主的融资选择

房屋净值信贷额度（HELOC）：大多数北温哥华业主拥有可观的房产净值。Scotiabank、TD及RBC提供年利率约prime+0.25%起的专用装修HELOC。

First National及Bridgewater Bank专门提供将购房或再融资与装修费用合并的承包商融资装修房贷。

BC首次购房者激励计划及RRSP购房者计划适用于同时购房和装修的情况。

Reno Stars在北温哥华

Reno Stars已完成北温哥华各社区的卫浴装修：Lynn Valley、Deep Cove、Blueridge、Canyon Heights、Norgate、Pemberton Heights、Westlynn、Upper Lonsdale、Lower Lonsdale、Hamilton及Capilano。我们熟悉CNV及DNV的许可证流程、1980年代以前住宅的石棉检测规程，以及在Lonsdale走廊陡峭地形物业工作的具体物流安排。

我们为北温哥华卫浴装修项目提供免费上门评估。在线联系我们或致电778-960-7999预约拜访。

北温哥华小型卫浴装修费用是多少

北温哥华小型卫浴翻新——新马桶、浴室柜、浴缸翻新、油漆及瓷砖填缝——费用为$18,000至$28,000。不涉及管道移动使费用保持在较低区间。

北温哥华卫浴装修需要许可证吗

如果您要移动管道、改动结构元件或变更承重墙，则需要建筑许可证。在北温哥华市或区，简单更换五金件而不涉及管道改动无需许可证。

北温哥华卫浴装修需要多长时间

北温哥华标准卫浴装修（无重大管道移动）从设计审批到交钥匙需5至8周。涉及管道移动的全拆重建需10至16周。
